interpretation_note: A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.020 is treated as a material AP change.
A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.050 is treated as a material MCC change.
A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.050 is treated as a material precision change.
A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.050 is treated as a material recall change.
A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.005 is treated as a material Brier-score change. Lower Brier is better.
A bootstrap interval entirely beyond +/-0.020 is treated as a material ECE change. Lower ECE is better.
A cost change is material if the bootstrap interval is entirely beyond this adaptive cost threshold. Lower cost is better.
EII >= 0.200 is treated as explanation-rank instability.
ERG > 1.000 indicates predictive shift exceeds explanation-rank instability by at least one AP materiality unit.
